titulo: A senhora do café (versão método: câmeras fixas, 1 pessoa por plano)
estilo: 1990s Brazilian TV drama, photorealistic, natural neutral colors, low saturation, soft overcast daylight from a window at screen left, realistic skin, subtle film texture. No text, no logos.
atuacao: Restrained, realistic TV drama acting, subtle micro-expressions only, no smiles, no grimaces, mouth closed when not speaking.

cenario.texto: small 1990s office reception, light beige walls, grey sofa, wooden door, light wooden counter. Keep its colors and light; background softly out of focus.

Helena.visual: woman about 60, grey hair in a low bun, grey knit cardigan over a cream blouse.
Helena.voz: woman about 60, low, calm, warm, unhurried, native Brazilian Portuguese, São Paulo accent

Paula.visual: woman about 28, straight dark brown hair, navy pantsuit over a white blouse, small gold earrings.
Paula.voz: young woman about 28, clear medium-high voice, bored and dismissive, low volume, native Brazilian Portuguese, São Paulo accent

Ana.visual: woman about 24, dark curly hair in a ponytail, open light blue shirt over a white t-shirt.
Ana.voz: young woman about 24, soft, friendly, warm, native Brazilian Portuguese, São Paulo accent

Joice.visual: woman about 30, short black bob, burgundy short-sleeve blouse.
Joice.voz: woman about 30, neutral, professional, quiet, native Brazilian Portuguese, São Paulo accent

planos.fala: Enche aí. E não demora, tá?
planos.quadro: Close-up at eye level of PAULA, alone in frame, seated on a grey sofa, head tilted down, eyes on a small dark 1990s mobile phone with a short antenna that she holds low in front of her. Bored. Shoulders and head fill the frame.
planos.movimento: Paula keeps her eyes down on the phone the whole time and speaks without looking up, barely moving.

planos.quadro: Medium close-up from a slightly low angle of HELENA, alone in frame, standing on the right half of the frame, body and face turned toward screen LEFT in three-quarter view (her nose points to the left edge of the image), eyes looking down to the lower left at someone seated off-screen. She holds a tall stainless steel coffee thermos with a black cap by its handle at chest height. Calm. The closed wooden door is out of focus behind her.
planos.movimento: Helena looks down toward screen left, pauses for a moment, then speaks calmly. She stays in place.

planos.fala: Deixa que eu ajudo a senhora.
planos.quadro: Close-up at eye level of ANA, alone in frame, seated on a grey sofa, face turned up toward screen right, looking at someone standing off-screen. Kind and attentive. Shoulders and head fill the frame.
planos.movimento: Ana looks up toward screen right and speaks gently. She stays seated.

planos.fala: Diretora, a sala já está pronta.
planos.quadro: Medium close-up of JOICE, alone in frame, seated behind a light wooden reception counter with a beige corded desk phone on it, her hands resting on the counter, looking toward screen left. Neutral, professional.
planos.movimento: Joice looks toward screen left and speaks in a respectful tone. She stays seated.
Paula freezes, then slowly lifts her eyes from the phone and looks up toward screen right, tense, and swallows. She lowers the phone a little.

planos.fala: Ana, pode entrar. Paula, o café estava do seu gosto?
planos.movimento: Helena first looks toward screen left and says the first sentence; short pause; then she lowers her gaze a little and says the second sentence in a polite, neutral tone. She stays in place.
